lines: Khusro rain suhaag ki, jaagi pi ke sang.
Tan mera, man pi ka, dono bhaye ek rang.
couplets.en: Khusro, I stayed awake with my beloved on our wedding night, my body and his heart dyed the same color.

lines: Seedha saada daakiya, jaadu kare mahaan.
Seedha saada daakiya, jaadu kare mahaan.
couplets.en: The humble postman works a wondrous magic.

lines: Seedha saada daakiya, jaadu kare mahaan.
Ek hi thaile mein bhare, aansu aur muskaan.
couplets.en: The humble postman works his magic, carrying tears and smiles in the same bag.

lines: Jaadu kare mahaan.
Ek hi thaile mein bhare, aansu aur muskaan.
couplets.en: What magic, to carry tears and smiles in the same bag.

lines: Main roya pardes mein, bheega maa ka pyaar.
Dukh ne dukh se baat ki, bin chitthi bin taar.
couplets.en: I wept far from home and my mother's love was wet with tears, one sorrow speaking to another without a letter or telegram.

lines: Isa, Allah, Ishwar, saare mantar seekh.
Jaane kab kis naam par mil jaaye bheekh.
couplets.en: Learn every invocation, Jesus, Allah, Ishwar, for who knows which name will bring you alms.

lines: Isa, Allah, Ishwar, saare mantar seekh.

couplets.en: Learn every invocation, Jesus, Allah, Ishwar, for who knows when or under which name.

lines: Bharat teri khoj.
Nehru ne likha nahin, kuli ke sar ka bojh.
couplets.en: India, Nehru's search for you left out the burden on the porter's head.

lines: Chaahe Geeta baanchiye, ya padhiye Quran.
Mera tera pyaar hi, har pustak ka gyaan.
couplets.en: Whether you read the Gita or the Quran, the love between us is the wisdom of every book.

lines: Bachcha bola dekh kar, masjid aalishaan.
Allah, tere ek ko itna bada makaan?
couplets.en: Seeing the splendid mosque, a child asked, Allah, such a large house just for you?

lines: Andar moorat pe chadhe, ghee poori mishthaan.
Mandir ke baahar khada, Ishwar maange daan.
couplets.en: Inside, ghee, fried bread and sweets are offered to the idol, while God stands outside the temple asking for alms.
